g.text: Accuracy–cost evidence: separate cohorts and explicit missing cells
Batch latency is not per-series latency. Existing CPU2 physical input → preprocessing → model → inverse → CPU return.
10 warmup / 20 timed / 20 separate stage trials; model cold load and training cost are separate. No invented zero costs.
Different C, recipes and selected epochs prevent a single global Pareto ranking. C32 B0/B2/no-Bolt are still unmeasured.
